verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus publishes a versioned public API (v2) with documented endpoints for contacts, lists, fields, campaign reports and starting automations, plus documented upserts, pagination, rate limits and API keys, so the product can be driven programmatically. Probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec, llms.txt or markdown docs, which leaves agents without a machine-readable contract. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use our API to give an application or website permission to interact with your EmailOctopus account.
Start an automation for a specific contact.
An upsert allows you to either update the entity if it exists or create a new one if it doesn't.
This system enables a steady request rate of up to 10 per second or a burst of up to 100 requests in a single instance if needed.
When you request a collection of entities, such as contacts belonging to a list, the data will be paginated rather than returned all at once.
